def test_no_network_blocks_default_ipv4_and_ipv6_socket_construction_and_restores(
    monkeypatch,
):
    original_socket = socket.socket
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "socket", original_socket)

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket()

        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)

        with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
            socket.socket(
                family=socket.AF_INET6,
                type=socket.SOCK_STREAM,
            )

    assert socket.socket is original_socket

        assert restored_socket.family == socket.AF_INET


def test_no_network_keeps_unix_sockets_and_socketpair_available(monkeypatch):
    if not hasattr(socket, "AF_UNIX"):
        pytest.skip("AF_UNIX is not available on this platform")

    original_socket = socket.socket
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "socket", original_socket)

    with netguard.NoNetwork():
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as unix_socket:
            assert unix_socket.family == socket.AF_UNIX

        left, right = socket.socketpair(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        with left, right:
            assert left.family == socket.AF_UNIX
            assert right.family == socket.AF_UNIX
            assert left.send(b"ping") == 4
            assert right.recv(4) == b"ping"

    assert socket.socket is original_socket
